message.content: Comments in this codebase use lowercase with square-bracket annotations as part of Protocol-7's consistent Perl-based multi-agent system style. The lowercase convention (`## read config ##` rather than `## Read Config ##`) enforces a uniform, machine-parseable format that avoids case-sensitivity issues and aligns with Perl's native lowercase sensitivity. Square-bracket annotations (`[ word ]`) are used instead of parentheses because they visually distinguish meta-annotations from actual code syntax, preventing confusion with function arguments or operator precedence, and they integrate cleanly with Perl's bracket-heavy syntax without creating ambiguity. Together, these conventions make the codebase more predictable for both human readers and automated tooling that processes P7 modules.
